title: Museums open to everyone
titleZh: 向每个人开放的博物馆
summaryZh: 英格兰国家博物馆将继续免费入馆。读懂9月29日的决定，以及“免费”与博物馆维修费用之间的关系。
levelReason: 围绕博物馆参观与免费入馆，用短句、常见动词和明确时间线；少量公共资金词带注释。 编辑估计，非认证CEFR测评。

source.name: Department for Digital, Culture, Media and Sport / GOV.UK
source.title: National museums to remain free for everyone

adaptation: 英语机构原文的同语言分级改写及逐句中文翻译；排除图片、标识、直接引语及链接第三方作品。区分公告时的计划、目标与已经实现的结果。口语问题及表达为教学补充。原语依据机构署名与英语编辑语境，不认证个人母语。

sentences.text: England’s national museums will continue to welcome visitors without an entry charge.
sentences.zh: 英格兰的国家博物馆将继续欢迎游客免费入馆。

glosses.note: 复数名词，指到博物馆参观的人。

sentences.text: On 29 September 2026, the government confirmed that entry would stay free for everyone.
sentences.zh: 2026年9月29日，政府确认每个人都将继续享有免费入馆的待遇。

glosses.note: 过去式，叙述9月29日的决定。

sentences.text: This includes people who live in other countries and come to England for a visit.
sentences.zh: 这也包括住在其他国家、到英格兰旅游的人。

sentences.text: The government had looked at charging overseas visitors to help museums pay their costs.
sentences.zh: 政府曾考虑向海外游客收费，以帮助博物馆支付开销。

sentences.text: But it decided not to introduce these charges.
sentences.zh: 但政府决定不引入这些收费。

sentences.text: It believes the change could also put people in Britain off visiting museums.
sentences.zh: 政府认为，这种变化也可能使英国本地的人不愿参观博物馆。

sentences.text: Free entry began in 2001, so it is already an important part of museum life.
sentences.zh: 免费入馆始于2001年，因此它已经是博物馆日常运营中的重要一环。

sentences.text: In 2025, the Natural History Museum received 7.1 million visitors, and the British Museum received 6.4 million.
sentences.zh: 2025年，自然历史博物馆接待了710万人次，大英博物馆接待了640万人次。

sentences.text: Keeping these places open also means looking after their buildings.
sentences.zh: 让这些场馆保持开放，也意味着要维护它们的建筑。

glosses.note: their后接复数名词，指博物馆建筑。

sentences.text: Government funding will help with repairs at national museums and other cultural organisations.
sentences.zh: 政府资金将帮助国家博物馆及其他文化机构开展维修。

sentences.text: Local and regional museums will receive support too.
sentences.zh: 地方和区域博物馆也将获得支持。

sentences.text: The government also plans to work with the museum sector on a long-term plan for its future.
sentences.zh: 政府还计划与博物馆行业合作，制定关于其未来的长期规划。

words.note: 复数名词，指到博物馆参观的人。
过去式，叙述9月29日的决定。
their后接复数名词，指博物馆建筑。

sentences.note: put someone off doing something表示让某人失去做某事的意愿；could保留政府判断的不确定性。
plans to +动词原形表达计划；on后说明合作的事项。

questions.text: What do you like to see in a museum?
questions.zh: 你喜欢在博物馆里看什么？

questions.text: Does free entry change how often you visit?
questions.zh: 免费入馆会影响你的参观频率吗？

expressions.text: I would visit more often if entry were free.
expressions.zh: 如果免费入馆，我会更常去参观。
expressions.note: 教学补充，用于讨论本文，不是来源引语。

expressions.text: A museum also needs money for repairs.
expressions.zh: 博物馆也需要资金进行维修。
expressions.note: 教学补充，用于讨论本文，不是来源引语。
